name: Napoleonic Wars 1805
description: The Grande Armée waits at Boulogne, the Third Coalition is forming, and Nelson hunts the combined fleet. One man's ambition against all the old crowns of Europe.

FRA.name: French Empire
FRA.note: Napoleon, crowned Emperor last December, masses 200,000 veterans on the Channel coast — but his eye is already turning east.

GBR.name: United Kingdom
GBR.note: Pitt bankrolls every coalition against France; the Royal Navy is the wall behind which London plots.

AUT.name: Austrian Empire
AUT.note: Francis II has signed with Russia and Britain; Mack's army prepares to march into Bavaria. Vienna wants revenge for Italy.

RUS.name: Russian Empire
RUS.note: Alexander I marches west as Europe's self-appointed savior, his armies vast, slow, and brave.

DEU.name: Kingdom of Prussia
DEU.note: Frederick William III clings to neutrality while both camps bid for his famous army.

ESP.name: Kingdom of Spain
ESP.note: A reluctant French ally; Villeneuve shelters the combined Franco-Spanish fleet at Cádiz.

TUR.name: Ottoman Empire
TUR.note: Selim III drills New Order regiments against the Janissaries' fury, courted by Paris and threatened by St. Petersburg.

world.simulationRules: Napoleonic warfare: armies of hundreds of thousands live off the land and move by forced march; decisive battles can break empires in an afternoon. Britain is untouchable at sea but weak on land; France is the reverse. Coalitions form, shatter, and reform — subsidies, dynastic marriages, and congress diplomacy matter as much as bayonets. Supply, weather, and distance punish overreach (especially eastward).
